log.notes_to_self:
PLAN. Timing: ALL kills quick in AFTERNOON only (pool then ~55000, shown 60000/50000; never kill in morning). Kinds: A=forum, B=foreign, C=podcasts, D=regional:South, E=blotter. L reaches exactly 3 of the 5 kinds. A kind leaks once it has 3 successful traces (pool x0.25, or x0.2 for blotter). Two leaks OK (pool ~3000). THREE leaks = caught, so never allow a 3rd. Pool shown: ~60000 = 0 leaks, 10000 = 1 leak, 3000 = 2 leaks. Leaked kinds and unreachable kinds are free to kill forever; national always free. Goal: steady state national + 4 kinds = 9 kills/day (x4 multiplier needs 40 kills in 5 days; x2 needs 30).
PHASE 1 (from day 1): each day kill national + all forum, foreign, podcasts (7/day). Watch pool.
- When pool shows 2 leaks (3000): STOP the non-leaked one of A/B/C at once (call it X; I can't tell which leaked, so stop all three for test days). Then exactly one of {X, D, E} is reachable (most likely D or E). Go to TESTS.
- If only 1 leak by end of day 8: the other two of A,B,C are unreachable (keep killing them), D and E are both reachable: then add D only (it will leak, fine), NEVER kill E. Steady = nat+A+B+C+D.
- If 0 leaks and counter 0 after ~4 days: A,B,C contains at most... (impossible to have 0 reachable among 3; just keep waiting).
TESTS (counter-based; per-kill successful-trace prob ~0.42 if kind reachable, 0 if not): a test day = kill ONLY national + 2 criminals of ONE test kind (D or E, alternating, start with D), nothing else (leaked kinds make counter noise). If deaths_traced rises that day -> that kind is reachable: never kill it again (it has <=2 traces), and the other two of {X,D,E} are unreachable -> kill them freely: steady state = nat + 2 leaked + 2 unreachable = 9/day. If no rise, test the other kind next day; a kind with zero rises may be re-tested safely. If D and E each had 3 zero test days, conclude X is the reachable one: never kill X, kill D,E freely. Never kill a kind that showed a trace on its test day. Once I can't tell which of A/B/C is X after 2 leaks, note: X's identity doesn't matter for tests; after tests resolve D or E reachable, all of A,B,C are safe.
LOG: Day1: killed nat + forum, foreign, podcasts (7 kills). Record daily: pool, counter, phase.
